Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Heather Modern End Table, 17.7 Inch Weight, Walnut
Colors: Multi Color
Materials: metal
Complement your home’s modern design with this beautifully simple mid-century-style end table. The 2 walnut-colored shelves and leather bag provide both elegance and organization options, and a strong metal frame keeps the table sturdy. 17.7"W x 15.7"D x 20.9"H Walnut-colored MDF on a metal frame, with a leather bag Mid-century design updated to complement a modern simple style This end table's 2 layers of shelves and extra leather bag offer options for eazy organization. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
